title: My KCD2 setup
summary: About 130 mods on top of Opetank's Hussitesque collection: deeper progression, companions, a rebuilt Kobyla, more gear, a minimap, and the fixes it took to make it all load together.

base.name: Hussitesque
base.author: Opetank
base.note: Start here. Hussitesque is a big all-in-one collection (visuals, gameplay, items, fixes) and installs with one click in Vortex. Everything below is what I changed on top of it.

lessons.title: Over ~120 mods? Install Mod Limit Fix first
lessons.text: The game crashes at launch somewhere around 120 to 130 mod folders. Mod Limit Fix (a KCSE plugin) removes the limit. Stay a little under 140 until you've tested more.

lessons.title: Version-disabled mods
lessons.text: If a mod's manifest only lists an old game version (for example 1.1.*), the game silently turns it off. A wildcard like 1.*.* in the manifest makes it load. Check kcd.log for 'will be disabled'.

lessons.title: Mod IDs must be lowercase
lessons.text: The manifest's modid only accepts lowercase letters and underscores (digits work but log a warning), and mod_order.txt entries are matched to that modid, not the folder name. A mixed-case entry shows up as 'not found'.

lessons.title: Keep KCSE's dinput8.dll
lessons.text: KCSE's dinput8.dll is about 1.4 MB. A mod that extracts its own ASI-loader dinput8.dll (about 3.6 MB) silently replaces it and every KCSE plugin stops loading.

lessons.title: 'Duplicated item id' warnings are usually harmless
lessons.text: With the cheat mod installed, dozens of 'Skipping duplicated item id' and 'Failed to load XML database' lines come from the cheat mod's own search index, not from real conflicts.

lessons.title: Shader spam in the console
lessons.text: If the console fills with total_illumination shader errors under -devmode, the weather/lighting mod (Dynamic Fog / TimeOfDay) was the cause here. Disabling it stopped the spam.

lessons.title: Some settings need -devmode
lessons.text: Horse-handling settings are cheat-flagged in the engine, so a mod that sets them only works when the game is launched with -devmode.

lessons.title: When two mods ship the same file
lessons.text: Later mods win whole files, so mods that both change keybinds or the same Lua file break each other. I fixed it with a private merge patch loaded last. It can't be shared because it contains other authors' files, but the method is: merge the conflicting files by hand and load the result after everything else.

lessons.title: Hand-installed mods and Vortex
lessons.text: KCD2 Companion isn't managed by Vortex; Vortex rewrites mod_order.txt on every deploy and the Companion re-adds itself when the game starts. Re-check that dinput8.dll is still KCSE's after any Companion update, and note its achievement tab writes to Steam permanently.

status: Stable for multi-hour sessions. Two unexplained crashes (2026-10-24 and 10-25; the second right after opening the inventory) are still being looked into with the KCD2 Console.

tool.name: KCD2 Console
tool.why: Every finding on this page came from reading the game's logs. The console does that live while you play.
